summary: Fix three code-review findings: ambiguous Playwright Back locator against the new fixed toolbar Back button, a restored Create VM draft losing an explicit zero-NIC state, and a stale guest-root-locked claim in the appliance deploy guide.

guide.reason: Corrected a stale sentence claiming guest root console login stays locked; appliance/firstboot.py's provision_console_login now unlocks it with the deploy password (and adds it to sudo where that group exists), matching the very next sentence on the same page. No operator steps changed, only the accuracy of that paragraph and its security implication.

api.reason: UI wizard-draft restore logic, a test locator fix, and a documentation correction; no Controller/Core API, contract, or wire behavior changed.

state.reason: No new or changed durable pool/Controller state. The wizard draft is an in-memory, unsubmitted request body kept only for retrying an uncertain submission (see vm-create.tsx's Draft comment); fixing what it restores does not add persistent state.

verification.method: cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run build (both clean). npm --prefix web run test (new `test` script running src/vm-create.test.mjs, added as a step after typecheck in both .github and .gitea phase1 workflows): added unit check exercises restoredNICs directly (extracted pure function) via an esbuild-transformed import of vm-create.tsx, covering explicit [] (preserved), undefined/non-array (falls back to the one-NIC template), and a populated array (preserved); confirmed it fails against the pre-fix `Array.isArray(r.nics) && r.nics.length` logic and passes after the fix. python3 -m py_compile tests/integration/managed_vm_browser.py. Ran the real simulated Playwright acceptance end-to-end: .cache/phase1-qa-venv/bin/python tests/integration/managed_vm_browser.py --simulated --evidence <scratchpad>/managed-vm-browser-run2 (all 5 phases PASS), which exercises the fixed step > 0 wizard Back button via the now-toolbar-scoped locator and confirms Playwright strict mode no longer throws now that the toolbar also has a Back button. python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree passes.
